process.title: How We Make Our Candles
process.subtitle: From raw materials to a finished product — every step is done with love
process.step1_desc: We carefully choose only natural soy wax, cotton wicks, and certified fragrance oils. Quality starts here.
process.step2_desc: The wax is melted at the exact right temperature — too hot damages the fragrance, too cold gives uneven texture.
process.step3_desc: Fragrance oils are blended in precise amounts for a balanced, long-lasting scent that fills the room.
process.step4_desc: The wax is carefully poured into each jar. We pour slowly to avoid air bubbles and ensure a smooth surface.
process.step5_desc: Candles cool at room temperature for 24 hours. Patience is key — rushing this step ruins the finish.
process.step6_desc: Each candle is trimmed, inspected, labelled by hand, and wrapped beautifully — ready for your home.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: The story behind Mamas Kerzen
about.story1: It all started in a small kitchen in Aachen, when I was expecting my first child. I wanted to fill our home with warmth and calm — but every candle I found in stores was packed with synthetic fragrances and paraffin wax. So I decided to make my own.
about.story2: What began as a hobby quickly became a passion. Months of testing natural soy wax blends, sourcing cotton wicks, crafting fragrance combinations by hand. My family and friends fell in love with the result — and Mamas Kerzen was born.
about.value1_desc: Only natural soy wax, cotton wicks, and phthalate-free fragrance oils. Nothing synthetic, nothing harmful.
about.value2_desc: Every single candle is hand-poured, hand-trimmed, and packaged by us. Never mass-produced.
about.value3_desc: Sustainable packaging, recyclable glass jars, and no harmful additives. We take care of our planet.
about.location_desc: All our candles are crafted in our small studio in Aachen, Germany. Every jar carries a little piece of home.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our candles
faq.q1: What type of wax do you use?
faq.a1: We use 100% natural soy wax, which burns cleaner and longer than paraffin. It's biodegradable and made from renewable resources.
faq.q2: How long do your candles burn?
faq.a2: Our candles burn for 35–50 hours, depending on the size. For best results, let the wax pool reach the edges on the very first burn.
faq.a3: Yes — we only use phthalate-free, skin-safe fragrance oils that comply with IFRA standards. No harmful chemicals.
faq.q4: How should I store my candles?
faq.a4: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Avoid temperatures above 25°C, as the wax can soften or discolor.
faq.a5: We currently ship within Germany and Austria. Sign up for our newsletter to be notified when we expand!
faq.a6: Yes — we accept returns within 14 days of delivery for unopened, unused products. Contact us to arrange a return.
faq.q7: How do I care for my candle?
faq.a7: Trim the wick to 5mm before each burn. Never burn for more than 4 hours at a time. Keep away from drafts and never leave unattended.
faq.a8: All orders come beautifully packaged. You can add a personal gift message — just mention it in the contact form when ordering.

care.title: Candle Care
care.subtitle: Get the most out of your candles
care.tip1_text: On the first burn, let the candle burn for at least 2 hours until the wax melts evenly to the edges.
care.tip2_text: Before each burn, trim the wick to about 5mm for a clean, even flame.
care.tip3_text: Keep candles away from drafts — this prevents uneven burning and excessive soot.
care.tip4_text: Never burn for more than 4 hours at a time. Let the candle cool completely before relighting.
care.tip5_text: Store in a cool, dark place away from direct sunlight to preserve fragrance and color.
care.tip6_text: Never leave a burning candle unattended and keep out of reach of children and pets.
